Great Experience
Jun 2019 • Couples
Visited here on the recommendation of Trip Advisor and and another website. Our last day of 17 day SE Asia trip in heat of summer so needless to say, the non-shopper in our duo was none to happy to wander around in 92 degrees. Stopped here, he got a fabulous egg coffee and was happy as a clam in the air conditioning with WiFi as I wandered around exploring 3 floors of beautiful handmade items, jewelry, clothing and embroidery. Settled on a beautiful hand painted linen dress that fit this size 14! Tough in Asia to find a dress bigger than American 8 so I was thrilled! Jewelry to match was also purchased and so I’m completely outfitted for an upcoming wedding for a fraction of what this outfit would have cost in California! Great customer service too! Highly recommend for unique clothing and souvenirs.

Lovely atmosphere, no bargains, but nice items
Nov 2015
We had been shopping in a number of other shops and enjoyed the quality of the ones on Silk Road (where Tanmy Design is located) the best. Everything in here is fixed price, and you're definitely not getting a bargain. However, things are on average a much higher quality, so you're not over-paying either. There is a good bit of clothing and much of it is generously sized for Westerner sizes. This is a bit more for expats or people who want to do more than souvenir shopping.
